rawContent: @Shelby_Dink @red_velvet_ari Keep in mind he had recently made a nasty joke about the POTUS and the #MeToo movement was in full swing.  At normal times we might have been able to separate truth from lies but it was just easy to “heard” us into believing the headlines.  So easy.

@privategirl207 @SassySupermom @rohitkulk29 @KyDUIGuy @jamesfromcourt I think Amber was very brilliant in the timing she chose. After Depp makes a joke about killing a president so he’s alienated a huge political block, it’s mid #MeToo and also when people were focused on politics in general so much we accepted what we were fed.

@ayshiicom @custodypeace @Eve_Barlow I can honestly say that I was put out with Depp because of what he joked about in regards to the president…but that was also during #metoo height and we never heard much about “what happened”.  Now that we HAVE it’s not hard to come to a determination as to who’s truthful
